steps.en: Customer gets a second reminder with a link
steps.id: Customer menerima reminder kedua berisi link
steps.why_en: No refund reminder or link exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Reminder refund dan link belum ada di sistem.

steps.en: Customer submits valid bank details within the period
steps.id: Customer mengisi bank account valid dalam periode
steps.why_en: The portal has no page to submit bank details for refunds.
steps.why_id: Portal tidak punya halaman untuk mengisi bank account refund.

steps.en: System finds refunds still unclaimed after the period
steps.id: Sistem menemukan refund yang masih belum diklaim setelah periode
steps.why_en: Nothing tracks whether a refund was claimed.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang melacak apakah refund sudah diklaim.

steps.en: A daily Excel refund report is generated automatically
steps.id: Report Excel refund harian dibuat otomatis
steps.why_en: The report lists all new refunds, not only unclaimed ones.
steps.why_id: Report memuat semua refund baru, bukan hanya yang belum diklaim.

steps.en: Report shows how many reminders were sent
steps.id: Report menampilkan jumlah reminder yang terkirim
steps.why_en: Reminder counts are neither stored nor shown.
steps.why_id: Jumlah reminder tidak disimpan maupun ditampilkan.

steps.en: The report is emailed to a fixed recipient list
steps.id: Report dikirim lewat email ke daftar penerima tetap
steps.why_en: Recipients are fixed addresses; Finance cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Penerima adalah alamat tetap; Finance tidak bisa dipastikan.
